namespace sample
{
    public class AxisAlignedBB
    {
        public double minX;

        public double minY;

        public double minZ;

        public double maxX;

        public double maxY;

        public double maxZ;

        public AxisAlignedBB(double var1, double var3, double var5, double var7, double var9, double var11)
        {
            minX = var1;
            minY = var3;
            minZ = var5;
            maxX = var7;
            maxY = var9;
            maxZ = var11;
        }

        public virtual bool intersectsWith(AxisAlignedBB var1)
        {
            if (var1.maxX <= minX || var1.minX >= maxX)
            {
                return false;
            }
            return var1.maxY > minY && var1.minY < maxY;
        }
    }
}

// Translated by CodeBreaker from FixtureMain (java).
using System;

namespace sample
{
    public class FixtureMain
    {
        public FixtureMain()
        {
        }

        public static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            double[] ds = new double[]
            {
                0.0,
                0.5,
                -0.5,
                1.999,
                -1.001,
                12345.678,
                -98765.4321
            };
            foreach (double d2 in ds)
            {
                Console.WriteLine("floor(" + JavaRt.Str(d2) + ")=" + MathHelper.floor_double(d2) + " sqrt=" + JavaRt.Str(MathHelper.sqrt_float((float)Math.Abs(d2))));
            }
            var a = new Vec3D(1.0, 2.0, 3.0);
            var b = new Vec3D(4.5, -2.0, 0.25);
            Vec3D d = a.subtract(b);
            Console.WriteLine("subtract " + JavaRt.Str(d.xCoord) + " " + JavaRt.Str(d.yCoord) + " " + JavaRt.Str(d.zCoord));
            Vec3D m = a.getIntermediateWithXValue(b, 2.0);
            Console.WriteLine("intermediate " + JavaRt.Str(m == null ? "null" : JavaRt.Str(m.xCoord) + "," + JavaRt.Str(m.yCoord) + "," + JavaRt.Str(m.zCoord)));
            Vec3D n = a.getIntermediateWithXValue(new Vec3D(1.0000001, 0.0, 0.0), 2.0);
            Console.WriteLine("near " + JavaRt.Str(n == null ? "null" : "made"));
            var box = new AxisAlignedBB(0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1);
            AxisAlignedBB[] others = new AxisAlignedBB[]
            {
                new AxisAlignedBB(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 2, 2, 2),
                new AxisAlignedBB(1, 0, 0, 2, 1, 1),
                new AxisAlignedBB(-1, -1, -1, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01),
                new AxisAlignedBB(0.2, 3, 0.2, 0.8, 4, 0.8)
            };
            foreach (AxisAlignedBB o in others)
            {
                Console.WriteLine("intersects " + JavaRt.Str(box.intersectsWith(o)));
            }
            Console.WriteLine("pool " + Vec3D.nextVector + " " + Vec3D.vectorList.Length);
        }
    }
}

using System;

namespace sample
{
    public class MathHelper
    {
        public MathHelper()
        {
        }

        private static float[] SIN_TABLE;

        public static float sqrt_float(float var0)
        {
            return (float)Math.Sqrt((double)var0);
        }

        public static int floor_double(double var0)
        {
            int var2 = (int)var0;
            return var0 < (double)var2 ? var2 - 1 : var2;
        }

        static MathHelper()
        {
            SIN_TABLE = new float[65536];
            for (int var0 = 0; var0 < 65536; ++var0)
            {
                SIN_TABLE[var0] = (float)Math.Sin((double)var0 * Math.PI * 2.0 / 65536.0);
            }
        }
    }
}

namespace sample
{
    public class Vec3D
    {
        public static int nextVector = 0;

        public static Vec3D[] vectorList = new Vec3D[256];

        public double xCoord;

        public double yCoord;

        public double zCoord;

        public Vec3D(double var1, double var3, double var5)
        {
            xCoord = var1;
            yCoord = var3;
            zCoord = var5;
        }

        public virtual Vec3D subtract(Vec3D var1)
        {
            return new Vec3D(var1.xCoord - xCoord, var1.yCoord - yCoord, var1.zCoord - zCoord);
        }

        public virtual Vec3D getIntermediateWithXValue(Vec3D var1, double var2)
        {
            double var4 = var1.xCoord - xCoord;
            if (var4 * var4 < 1E-07)
            {
                return null;
            }
            return new Vec3D(var2, yCoord, zCoord);
        }
    }
}
